record.question: Who is the author of the book, "Mitthi Privatise"?
record.explanation: Mitthi Privatise is by Vanramchhuangi, also known as Ruatfela Nu. The contemporary report of the September 2013 book launch names both identities, so this appearance’s option at index 2 is the author. Reference: https://lenkawl.khampat.com/2013/09/mitthi-inbuaipui-dan-ennawna-ngaihtuah.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
